title: Derived open-extension and restriction site comparisons
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], exact comparison $C_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], and the canonical inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Define $C_XDj_!^e\cong Dj_!^pC_U$ by descending the adjoint-normalized sheaf extension comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] termwise to complexes, followed by the canonical derived-composition isomorphisms. Define $C_ULj_e^*\cong Lj_p^*C_X$ by the canonical sheaf inverse-image comparison and the exact-to-left-derived identifications on each site. These specified isomorphisms contain no assertion about the tensor projection maps.

def openProjectionExtensionComparison (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategory
